summary.text: Bruce Gillespie, also known as Butch, is a Republican member of the Montana State Senate, representing District 9 since January 7, 2019, who is not seeking re-election to the Senate and is instead the Republican candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 18, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Bruce Gillespie first won the Senate District 9 seat in the November 6, 2018 general election, defeating Kurt Dyer, and was re-elected on November 8, 2022 with 6,780 votes in a race with no other candidate listed.
His current Senate term ends on January 4, 2027.

In the 2025-2026 session, Gillespie chaired the Senate Agriculture, Livestock and Irrigation Committee and served on the Business, Labor and Economic Affairs Committee and the Senate Natural Resources Committee.
He was vice chair of the Agriculture, Livestock and Irrigation Committee in 2023-2024.
Gillespie advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary for House District 18 with 2,769 votes, unopposed on the ballot.
Ballotpedia lists him as the only candidate in the House District 18 general election, and reports that the Democratic primary scheduled for June 2, 2026 was canceled.
